status.evidence: According to Endole, Franstrack Ltd is an active company incorporated on 3 November 2025 with its registered office located in Bootle, Merseyside.

claims.claim: The company reports that its fleet management and telematics platform supports more than 3,000 devices with 24/7 uptime and provides real-time GPS tracking, according to the official Franstrack Website.

The company reports that its enterprise-grade fleet management and telematics platform supports more than 3,000 devices with features including real-time GPS tracking, excessive idling monitoring, speeding incident reports, geofencing, and daily utilization dashboards as detailed on the Franstrack Official Website.

The company reports that it offers hardware packages from £119 and provides rapid deployment with system setup and equipment shipment completed under 48 hours, supporting a fleet platform designed for 3,000+ connected devices as documented on the official Franstrack Platform.
Franstrack Ltd is registered as a Tier 1 data controller with the UK Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) under registration reference ZC149464.
